description: One line of the library's change log, version 1, appended to .neo/changes.jsonl when a page comes into the wiki (page-imported), a page is updated from a newer source (page-updated), or an image or PDF a page names is copied into the wiki book (attachment-imported, with the chId of the page that brought it). Ripple reads the log later; nothing reads it yet.

dest.description: The chapter file, or the attachment, relative to the library, with forward slashes.

src.description: The file it came from, as picked or as found.
